title: Severe faculty cadre ratio deficiency and unapproved adjunct appointments in B.Tech CSE
description: Audit reveals faculty-student ratio dropped to 1:34 against mandatory 1:20 norm due to mass resignations and ghost faculty listed on muster rolls.

title: Excess admission beyond AICTE approved intake in MCA and MBA programmes
description: Institution admitted 42 supernumerary students above the sanctioned EoA intake without statutory approval, violating AICTE Regulation Bureau norms.

title: Collection of illegal capitation fee and unapproved institutional development charges
description: Management is forcing first-year engineering admits to pay cash capitation donations outside the state fee regulatory committee structure.

title: Operation of unapproved off-campus study center and franchise technical diploma
description: Institute is running unauthorized off-campus B.Tech classes in a commercial complex without AICTE statutory approval or show-cause clearance.

title: Violation of AICTE Principal qualification norms and cadre structure
description: Acting principal lacks Ph.D. and minimum professor cadre experience mandated under AICTE Regulation Bureau statutory gazette notifications.

title: Show-cause notice compliance failure regarding duplicate faculty PAN registrations
description: Twelve faculty members shown on regular payroll are simultaneously registered full-time at sister institutions under the same educational trust.

title: Non-compliance with Expert Visit Committee EVC deficiency rectification directive
description: Institution failed to rectify critical instructional area and professor cadre deficiencies within 60 days of Regulation Bureau EVC inspection.

title: Misrepresentation of land ownership and built-up Carpet Area in statutory regulatory filing
description: Vigilance inquiry indicates mortgaged institutional land and shared classrooms with a non-technical degree college violating AICTE regulatory norms.

title: Statutory norm violation through 48% faculty cadre deficit and biometric attendance manipulation
description: Regulation Bureau complaint regarding acute shortage of regular associate professors and fabricated faculty roster during statutory scrutiny.

title: Unauthorized excess intake admission and capitation fee demand in B.Tech AI
description: Complaint alleging unapproved excess admission above sanctioned intake and mandatory cash capitation fee collection in violation of AICTE regulations.

title: Show-cause inquiry on non-existent Ph.D. cadre faculty and norm violation
description: Statutory complaint to Regulation Bureau reporting zero regular professors in ECE and Mechanical departments against mandatory cadre ratio norms.

title: Breach of AICTE punitive action order on reduced intake compliance
description: Despite Regulation Bureau 25% intake reduction penalty for regulatory deficiencies, institution admitted full batch without statutory restoration.

title: Non-refund of tuition fee after admission cancellation within AICTE counselling deadline
description: Student withdrew admission before last round of counselling, but college refuses to refund Rs 92,000 tuition fee and retains original mark sheets.

title: Pragati Scholarship institute-level verification pending on National Scholarship Portal
description: Thirty-four eligible girl students awaiting nodal officer verification for AICTE Pragati scholarship disbursement before portal cutoff.

title: Original 10th and 12th mark sheets withheld by college registrar to block student transfer
description: Public grievance alleging illegal retention of original academic certificates and demand of full 4-year tuition fee for issuing transfer certificate.

title: Saksham Scholarship disability certificate re-upload and DBT disbursement delay
description: Specially-abled B.Tech student requests PGRC intervention to re-enable Saksham scholarship document verification and release pending DBT fellowship.

title: University examination roll numbers not issued to admitted first-year MCA students
description: Admitted MCA students filed public grievance with PGRC after failing to receive university enrollment and exam hall tickets two weeks before finals.

title: Academic Bank of Credits ABC ID mapping error for lateral entry diploma students
description: Second-year lateral entry engineering students unable to renew PM-USP scholarship due to unmapped ABC IDs in the institutional student registry.

title: Student harassment and arbitrary hostel expulsion without Student Grievance Redressal Committee hearing
description: Complainant reports functional failure of internal SGRC cell and unfair fine imposed on students raising mess hygiene and hostel safety grievances.

title: ATAL Academy FDP participation certificate synchronization delay on portal
description: Participants of 6-day ATAL Academy training programme have not received digital certificates in their public grievance portal dashboard.

title: Refusal to refund admission tuition fee and retention of original migration certificate
description: Student stakeholder grievance requesting immediate fee refund and release of withheld original certificates under AICTE PGRC refund rules.

title: Delay in AICTE Pragati and Saksham scholarship DBT verification by institute nodal officer
description: Public grievance from students regarding pending scholarship verification and delayed fellowship disbursement on the NSP portal.

title: Withheld original degree certificates and arbitrary caution deposit deduction for graduating batch
description: Graduating B.Pharm students report that college administration withheld provisional certificates and refused caution money fee refund.

title: Non-disbursement of GATE PG scholarship stipend to M.Tech regular scholars
description: Postgraduate M.Tech GATE qualified students have not received monthly AICTE PG scholarship stipend for four consecutive months due to attendance upload lag.

title: Extension of Approval EoA 2026-27 seat intake discrepancy in B.Tech AI and Data Science
description: Approval Bureau EoA letter reflects 60 seats instead of 120 approved seats despite compliant laboratory equipment affidavit and scrutiny clearance.

title: Compliance affidavit and laboratory stock register update for EoA 2026-27 cycle
description: Submission of updated CAD/CAM workstation laboratory inventory and fire safety renewal affidavit for annual Extension of Approval.

title: Application for progressive closure of second-shift Diploma programme and intake reduction
description: Institution seeks Approval Bureau clearance for progressive closure of under-enrolled Diploma shift and revision of sanctioned EoA intake.

title: Introduction of new emerging area B.Tech Cyber Security course in EoA approval letter
description: Request to Approval Bureau for issuance of revised EoA corrigendum incorporating NBA accreditation status and additional 60 seat intake.

title: Conversion of women-only technical institution to co-educational status in EoA portal
description: Submission of Trust resolution, digital compliance affidavit, and scrutiny fee receipt to Approval Bureau for EoA institutional category conversion.

title: Merger of two child institutions under single AICTE Permanent ID and EoA consolidation
description: Application under Approval Process Handbook for amalgamation of pharmacy and engineering campuses into a single consolidated Extension of Approval letter.

title: Restoration of intake seats following NBA accreditation renewal submission to Approval Bureau
description: Institute uploaded valid 3-year NBA accreditation letter and compliance affidavit requesting restoration of 180 B.Tech Mechanical intake in EoA.

title: Correction of programme nomenclature in Extension of Approval EoA 2026-27 certificate
description: Clerical mismatch between university syllabus title and Approval Bureau EoA approval letter for M.Tech Structural Engineering.

title: Discrepancy in sanctioned seat intake and laboratory compliance affidavit on EoA approval letter
description: Petition to Approval Bureau regarding Extension of Approval EoA seat intake corrigendum and scrutiny of laboratory readiness.

title: Annual EoA extension of approval application and NBA accreditation intake increase
description: Approval Bureau filing for seat intake expansion from 60 to 120 based on valid accreditation and updated instructional laboratory compliance affidavit.

title: Submission of digital scrutiny affidavit and laboratory stock register for EoA
description: Routine Extension of Approval EoA documentation update for computer science laboratories and annual intake confirmation.

title: Approval Bureau scrutiny of supernumerary Tuition Fee Waiver TFW seat allocation in EoA
description: Request to verify 5% TFW supernumerary intake quota calculation in the institutional Extension of Approval table.

title: Six-month salary arrears and withheld relieving letter for resigning engineering faculty
description: Assistant professors in CSE department report unpaid salary for 6 months, non-remittance of EPF, and refusal to issue relieving and experience certificates.

title: Delayed Career Advancement Scheme CAS promotion and 7th CPC pay scale arrears
description: Senior Mechanical Engineering faculty members have not received 7th Central Pay Commission scale implementation and CAS stage promotion arrears.

title: Arbitrary termination of regular faculty without notice period or service book settlement
description: Faculty Grievance Cell complaint against sudden termination of five regular lecturers mid-semester without three months notice pay or experience certificate.

title: Non-payment of Dearness Allowance DA and forced signature on full salary acquittance roll
description: College credits 50% below AICTE 7th CPC pay scale into bank accounts while coercing faculty to sign full salary vouchers.

title: Retention of original Ph.D. degree certificate and service book of Assistant Professor
description: Faculty member selected at NIT is unable to join because private engineering college management refuses to release relieving letter and original degree.

title: Denial of maternity leave salary and Ph.D. increment under AICTE service regulations
description: Associate Professor denied statutory maternity leave benefits and three non-compounded Ph.D. increments mandated under 7th CPC pay norms.

title: Unpaid gratuity and provident fund arrears for retired polytechnic head of department
description: Retired HoD petitions Faculty Grievance Cell for release of 14 months pending salary arrears, gratuity, and updated service book.

title: Unlawful salary deduction during summer vacation break for regular teaching faculty
description: Management withholds June and July salary every academic year for regular faculty despite continuous multi-year service.

title: Non-payment of 8 months faculty salary arrears and withheld relieving order after resignation
description: Resigning faculty members petition Faculty Grievance Cell over unpaid 7th CPC salary arrears, withheld experience certificate, and relieving letter.

title: Non-implementation of 7th CPC pay scale and CAS promotion for senior professors
description: Faculty service grievance regarding stagnation in 6th pay commission scale, unpaid DA arrears, and blocked Career Advancement Scheme promotion.

title: Refusal to issue faculty experience certificate and service book upon completion of notice period
description: Assistant professor completed 3-month notice period after resignation but management refuses to issue relieving letter and pending salary.

title: Withholding of AICTE QIP study leave salary for faculty pursuing doctoral research
description: Sponsored QIP scholar reports stoppage of monthly salary and allowances by parent engineering institution during approved study leave.

title: Regional Scrutiny Committee physical site visit report for campus address verification
description: Regional Office field inspection conducted to verify campus boundary demarcation, land conversion certificate, and university affiliation NOC.

title: Local verification of barrier-free built environment and ramp compliance by Regional Office
description: Submission of physical inspection photographs and structural audit report to Regional Office following regional observation on PWD accessibility.

title: State DTE and affiliating university NOC verification for campus location change
description: Regional Office liaison desk verifying state government NOC and university affiliation concurrence for shifting campus within the same district.

title: Regional physical verification of newly constructed workshop and high-voltage laboratory
description: Regional Officer site visit to verify completion of civil construction, occupancy certificate, and physical readiness of electrical labs.

title: Campus identity and Permanent ID verification by Regional Office in industrial corridor
description: Regional verification desk tasked with physical site inspection to confirm whether two similarly named campuses share a single AICTE Permanent ID.

title: Verification of state pollution control board and municipal fire NOC by Regional Office
description: Local inspection team verifying authenticity of municipal building plan approval and regional statutory safety certificates.

title: Regional Office joint verification with affiliating technological university registrar
description: Coordination between Regional Officer and state technical university to reconcile physical classroom capacity and affiliation NOC.

title: Site visit verification of rain-water harvesting and solar power installation at regional campus
description: Regional Office compliance check on green campus infrastructure and local panchayat building land records.

title: Regional Office physical site visit and local verification of university affiliation NOC
description: Regional scrutiny team conducted physical verification of campus address, land records, and affiliating university NOC compliance.

title: Local verification of campus barrier-free ramp and building occupancy certificate by Regional Officer
description: Regional verification of physical infrastructure, municipal occupancy certificate, and site visit compliance observations.

title: Verification of campus address and state DTE NOC by Regional Office inspection committee
description: Site visit report from Regional Office confirming physical campus boundaries and state DTE no-objection certificate.

title: Regional inspection of hostel building safety and local district collector land certificate
description: Field verification by Regional Office committee to authenticate district revenue land title and physical hostel blocks.
